levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري
أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: rule 11: a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks and acts; Hanan ibn Sadir's visit is in the scene, so whether the Imam is a source or only in the story needs a ruling
«أبي عبد الله» is the second occurrence: the first sits inside «أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي»; «رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى» names the Imam as a narrator after «إلى»
«حنان بن سدير» is a figure in the scene, not a link (rule 6)
